abstract: Gestational trophoblastic diseases comprise a rare spectrum of disorders in which the normal regulatory mechanisms controlling the behavior of trophoblastic tissue are lost. They vary from the benign complete and partial hydatidiform moles to the frankly malignant choriocarcinoma and placental site trophoblastic tumors. The majority will be cured by suction curettage, followed by human chorionic gonadotrphin screening but some will go on to need chemotherapy. The majority of patients will be cured even despite the presence of metastatic disease. Patients should have their treatment stratified according to various prognostic factors in order to ensure firstly their disease is eliminated and secondly to reduce the incidence of long-term treatment complications.
abstract_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患は、絨毛性栄養膜の挙動を制御する正常な機構が失われる、まれな疾患群である。良性の完全胞状奇胎および部分胞状奇胎から、明らかな悪性である絨毛癌および胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍までを含む。大多数は吸引掻爬とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピンのスクリーニングで治癒するが、一部は化学療法を要する。転移性疾患が存在する場合でも、大多数の患者は治癒する。患者の治療は、まず疾患の消失を確実にし、次に長期的な治療合併症の発生率を減らすために、様々な予後因子に基づいて層別化されるべきである。
